incident_context.root_cause: FE deploy run 38029795121 failed at prepare stage because 'npx playwright install chromium --with-deps' attempted to run global system apt-get update via sudo, which failed with exit code 100 due to an unrelated HTTP 402 Payment Required from Cloudsmith Debian repository for Caddy. Preprovisioned self-hosted VM already has required system libraries.
incident_context.resolution: Removed '--with-deps' from routine ensure_probe_dependencies to avoid unnecessary apt updates on the provisioned host. Added fail-closed browser availability preflight using headless Chromium launch and close before prepare seal and switch.

scope: Use only original locked Playwright Chromium on preprovisioned target and avoid global apt update in routine ensure_probe_dependencies; npm ci and browser availability remain verified.

Missing Chromium or shared libraries must fail closed before prepare seal and before switch through actual headless browser launch and close; never skip BrowserSmoke or weaken auth readiness lease CAS evidence checks.

Original deployment contract harness reproduces old apt402 failure with controlled mock and proves ready runtime success without apt and missing runtime failure; all existing cases still executed with honest no-skip results.

Do not remove Caddy repository or its signature policy or change VM system config; no credentials network provider substitution or hosted mutations by worker; current environment identities from Pantheon latest docs not stale FE AGENTS retired origins.

Only three declared files and production net increase at most 40; no changes to product UI data or global CI browser deps; reviewer exacthead requiredCI and merge to current FE dev before solecoordinator exactpair qualification and hosted retry.
Keep actual FE38029795121 failure with Root38027568953 parent and old gate38028828417; newFEmerge requires own fresh gate and exactcandidate pins not reused old qualification.
